questions: Did these movements begin suddenly, over seconds to hours?
Did they begin within the last 24 hours?
Have you had any weakness or numbness on the affected side?
Have you had trouble speaking, understanding speech, seeing, walking, or keeping your balance?
Has one side of your face drooped or moved abnormally?
Have you had a sudden severe headache, dizziness, vomiting, or loss of consciousness?
Do the movements continue while you are asleep?
Can you temporarily suppress or stop the movements?
Do you remain fully aware and able to respond during the movements?
Do you have diabetes?
Have you had unusually high blood sugar recently?
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed the dose of any medication?
Do you take levodopa, antipsychotic, anti-nausea, stimulant, seizure, or steroid medication?
Have you used cocaine, amphetamines, or other recreational stimulants recently?
Have you recently had a fever, sore throat, or other significant infection?
Have you recently had a head injury?
Have you ever had similar involuntary movements before?
Has anyone in your family had similar movements or been diagnosed with Huntington disease?
Have you had recent unexplained weight loss, night sweats, or a history of cancer?
Could you be pregnant?
